first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-slung sports car continuously tracked in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A white low-slung sports car continuously ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark horizontal area and red light points at the rear.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved racetrack extending from the lower part of the image toward the distant entrance.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The low-texture blue-gray sky above the treetops, brighter near gaps between the distant treetops.

entities.name: orange-lit tunnel entrance
entities.identification: The arched entrance among the trees at the far end of the racetrack, with an orange-yellow bright area inside and a dark area on the left.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: A white vehicle with a relatively tall body outside the barrier on the left, with a red horizontal area below the dark front window.

entities.name: group of staff in orange
entities.identification: Multiple human figures in orange clothing in the separated areas on both sides of the racetrack, corresponding collectively as a background group.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white curb distributed along the white boundary line on the left side of the racetrack.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The gray solid low walls on both sides of the racetrack, with gaps between wall sections visible on the right in the final frame.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The tall-post mesh fence atop the wall on the left in the first frame, as well as the distant fence portion in the final frame.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense dark-green trees distributed on both sides of the racetrack and in the distance, with treetops of varying heights.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The portion that can be confirmed in this clip consists of rectangular advertising boards stacked vertically on both sides of the gantry.

entities.name: roadside lattice tower
entities.identification: The slender gray lattice tower body in the upper right, with multiple tiers of horizontal components in its upper part.

entities.name: gantry spanning the racetrack
entities.identification: A gate-shaped structure composed of lattice supports on both sides and a dark banner spanning the road above.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The low, green strip of ground between the left road boundary and the barrier.
